name: Miraflores (Boyacá, Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of red and green with a white diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with a yellow five-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Miraflores, a municipality in the department of Boyacá, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
